_notes: Boss loot for Scholomance, Stratholme (both halves) and Hearthglen (56-60). ONE item per kill from the boss's three; the Barovs share nine and drop three. item_level = boss level + 3. Hand-authored in tools/build_plaguelands_dungeons_content.py.

proc.describe: Your damaging spells have a chance to grant 40 spell power for 3 turns.
Your healing spells have a chance to grant 56 healing power for 3 turns.
Your attacks have a chance to grant 80 attack power for 3 turns.
Your attacks have a chance to grant 10% haste for 3 turns.
When you are hit, you have a chance to gain 70 attack power and 300 armour for 3 turns.
